scope: Fix the recurring acknowledgement buffering regression in the governed collector; not acceptance of a lower-effort default or closure of issue 53.

cause.behavior: No on_delta callback reached CodexConnection.turn. The only callback ran after full proposal validation and app-server cleanup, withholding the complete safe acknowledgement.
cause.observed_before_fix: Assertion failed: visible acknowledgement was empty while the provider had delivered its complete acknowledgement and remained blocked generating the private proposal.

fix: Parse raw deltas with the existing complete-acknowledgement validator; also enforce the historical-context acknowledgement restriction before publication.
Keep private plans and questions hidden until complete validation and required persistence.
Preserve the three-attempt fresh-home retry bound and original overall timeout. Freeze an acknowledgement already shown into the retry schema and verify exact agreement in the validated result.
Count the frozen acknowledgement schema against the existing input budget before another dispatch.
Emit privacy-safe app-server admission, first nonempty delta, and message-completion timings.

live_configuration.activation: Restarted the idle local private worker, then refreshed existing Compose host aliases for its new address.
live_configuration.measurement: HTTP events from the existing web proxy using fresh synthetic identities, not browser paint. These are unpaired observations, not a latency distribution or evidence of end-to-end speed improvement.

live_observations.outcome: Worker connection failed before model dispatch because API's static host alias retained the old worker address. Existing refresh_mocker_compose_hosts.py repaired it. Not a passing generation.

live_observations.interpretation: The acknowledgement arrived 3.666s before collector completion. The app-server waited 26.628s for its first raw text delta; removing application buffering cannot remove that upstream generation delay.

verification.coverage: Actual API and private worker ASGI with real disposable PostgreSQL, only model I/O substituted. Early acknowledgement in both execution modes, zero completed rounds before release, one durable save, idempotent replay, publication and cancellation fences.

broader_verification_limitations: test_codex_worker.py and test_turn_stream.py: 34 failures and 17 passes; the same 34 failures were reproduced with the unmodified HEAD engine. Fixtures call retired legacy paths or omit the required canonical execution contract.

A broader four-file native PostgreSQL run was interrupted after 236s with 20 failures and 10 passes. Observed failures included retired iter_artifacts hooks and non-NDJSON worker fixtures. This was not a complete green run and its failures were not all independently baseline-verified.
The broader test_diagnostics.py selection had three failures from the removed legacy worker contract/workspace methods, alongside 20 passes including the new protocol tests.
remaining: Current max-effort upstream first-delta latency remains substantial and variable. The opt-in low route has not passed the documented representative quality/latency release gate. No route rollout, production latency claim, or issue closure follows from this fix.
